prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='NaiveSeasonal', seasonality_champion='ONLY_FT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: NaiveSeasonal achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) by design, while ONLY_FT_catboost best captures seasonality (0.452 correlation). FT_rf wins overall with lowest RMSE (28.99), but the series is highly unpredictable (spectral entropy 0.86) and rankings are unstable (Kendall τ=-0.24), making robust median/trimmed_mean combinations preferable over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
